description: Source code for DHCPv4 client API functions, including configuration management, interface control, and DHCP server interaction, with embedded license info and various utility functions.

methods.name: RestartDnsmasq
methods.description: Restarts dnsmasq service by killing and relaunching.

methods.name: CcspHalGetConfigValues
methods.description: Retrieves current DHCP configuration values from dnsmasq config.

methods.name: CcspHalSetDHCPConfigValues
methods.description: Sets DHCP configuration parameters in dnsmasq config.

methods.name: CcspHalInterfacesetval
methods.description: Sets the gateway IP address on a network interface.

methods.name: CcspHalNetmasksetvalue
methods.description: Sets the subnet mask on a network interface.

methods.name: CcspHalGetPIDbyName
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID of DHCP server by name.

methods.name: CcspHalNoofClientConnected
methods.description: Returns the number of connected clients.

methods.name: checkLan
methods.description: Checks LAN interface status.

methods.name: CcspHalUpdateInterfaceval
methods.description: Updates the gateway IP address in web server config.

methods.name: updateReservedIp
methods.description: Updates existing reserved IP in static table.

methods.name: CcspHalDHCPv4ReservedClients
methods.description: Adds a reserved IP entry for a client.

methods.name: CcspHalDHCPv4DeleteReservedClients
methods.description: Deletes a reserved IP entry.

methods.name: GetInterfaceMacAddressValue
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address or sets default if interface absent.

methods.name: CcspHalGetInterfaceDetails
methods.description: Gets details (name, MAC) of network interfaces.

methods.name: CcspHalGetInterfaceStatusDetails
methods.description: Gets operational status of network interfaces.

methods.name: CcspHalSetInterfaceEnableDetails
methods.description: Enables or disables network interfaces.

methods.name: CcspHalGetInterfaceEnableDetails
methods.description: Checks if network interfaces are enabled.

methods.name: CcspHalGetBridgePortNames
methods.description: Retrieves bridge port names based on instance and index.

methods.name: GetBridgePortStatus
methods.description: Gets operational status of a bridge port.

methods.name: CcspHalGetBridgePortStatus
methods.description: Returns status of specified bridge port.

methods.name: GetBridgePortEnable
methods.description: Checks if bridge port is enabled.

methods.name: CcspHalGetBridgePortEnable
methods.description: Returns enable status of bridge port.

methods.name: CcspHalGetBridgePortStats
methods.description: Provides statistics for bridge port.

methods.name: CcspHaldhcpv4cGetGw
methods.description: Gets WAN default gateway address.

methods.name: CcspHalGetDNSServerValue
methods.description: Retrieves DNS server address.

methods.name: CcspHalGetWanAddressMode
methods.description: Determines if DHCP is enabled for WAN.

methods.name: CcspHalDhcpcGetInfo
methods.description: Gets remaining lease time for DHCP clients.
